def: a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah

occurrences.text: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.
Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi–ezer the Antothite,
The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.
After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
